overview.text: Today's key developments highlight major shifts in industry leadership, local inference tooling, and model architecture. First, NVIDIA announced a significant CEO transition as the company prepares to move past Jensen Huang. In local inference, Huawei released MACaQ as an internal quantizer supporting text, image, video, and audio models across multiple popular runtimes. Meanwhile, Tencent developed a new speculative decoding method tied to Qwen3.8-27B-DSpine-b16 that enables faster decoding for large models. In research, new techniques like SteerDistill address low-bit quantization for LLM agents, and GTAGym introduces a real AAA game tasks environment for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. These updates collectively point to continued optimization in deployment costs and new evaluation paradigms for interactive agents.

entries.title: One Table, Many Queries: Benchmarking Generalist Tabular Models Across Generation, Imputation, and Prediction
entries.summary: Generation, imputation, and prediction query different aspects of the same tabular distribution, but are usually evaluated separately. This leaves unclear which capabilities they share, how their training objectives interact, and whether one model can perform all three well.
entries.why: This benchmark evaluates generalist tabular models across generation, imputation, and prediction tasks.
